From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@heliotech.com>, Mei Chen <mei.chen@procure.helio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T14:15:00-08:00
Subject: Confirming econ contact & security route for Redwood trial — HelioTech

Hi Liam / Mei —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from my side and a few asks so we can lock the trial logistics:  

Recap (30m discovery):
- Use case: HelioTech wants to add a realtime code-assist feature inside their internal developer portal; expected initial scope ~10 devs, ramp to 80 over 90 days.
- Success metrics: latency <200ms for 512-token responses, monthly cost target ~$3k–5k for POC, and no egress of sensitive source code outside VPC (privacy requirement).
- Technical constraints: on-prem proxy for code repos; security will need SOC 2 evidence and an IP allowlist.

Asks / next steps I can own:
1) Confirm the economic buyer / budget owner who will sign the POC commitment and approve credits for the trial.
2) Security & legal contacts for questionnaire review (we attach the procurement questionnaire + SOC artifact pointers).
3) Target procurement timeline and any PO/contract reviewers we should expect.
4) Agree a date for the kickoff call with SEs (Jordan) — I proposed Nov 10–12; LMK what works.

I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (HelioTech_Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf) and a preliminary trial quote (redwood-trial-quote-HelioTech.xlsx) — both editable. If you can reply with the econ contact and security reviewer, I will loop them into the MAP and send a short procurement packet.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: HelioTech_Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (application/pdf), redwood-trial-quote-HelioTech.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Great note. A couple quick internal thoughts before you hear back:  
- Offer: Recommend we frame the trial as a 90-day POC with $4k in platform credits + one week of dedicated SE time (Jordan). Helps address both cost and velocity asks.
- Commercial: If econ buyer asks for pricing upside, we can propose a two-tier committed discount on month-to-month after POC.
- Ask you to push for a named PO owner (finance person) — that speeds procurement.

If Liam confirms Asha as the econ buyer, I'll prep a short concession doc that lists credit structure and renewal pricing.

Thanks —

Hi all — quick technical check before we lock dates:  

- Network: For the VPC-onboarding path, will HelioTech provide a NAT egress IP or do you prefer a customer-managed bastion for initial KV/cache isolation? If egress is restricted, we’ll need the IPs to allowlist.
- Data flow: To confirm, code snippets will be masked before leaving the environment; we should map which repo endpoints are in scope for the POC.
- SE kickoff: My availability Nov 10 (AM PT) and Nov 11 (anytime PT). Propose a 45-minute call to map integration points, auth, and sample payloads.

Attached is a short checklist (included inline in the MAP) — I’ll prepare a simple architecture slide for the kickoff.

Jordan Blake

Hi Marissa / Jordan —

Thanks for the thorough note and plan. Two quick confirmations from our side:  

1) Economic buyer / budget owner: Asha Patel (VP Finance) will own the budget for the POC and shepherd the PO. She’s looped above and happy to take the MAP. Asha — we expect Redwood is offering the $4k credit callout; Ben, can you send the concession outline?

2) Security & procurement: Rajiv Kapoor (copied) will handle the initial security review; Mei is our procurement lead and will manage the contract routing. We’ve attached our standard procurement questionnaire — attaching back here for Redwood to review (HelioTech_procurement_questionnaire.docx).

On logistics: Nov 11 at 10:00 AM PT works for the SE kickoff (Jordan). We will provide NAT egress IPs for allowlisting by EOD Monday (Nov 8). Also, we need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short dataflow diagram for our security review — Jordan, can you include that in the kickoff slides?

Next steps (agreed):
- Ben: send concession + trial credit confirmation (Ben.action)
- Marissa: update MAP with econ owner (Asha) and share DocuSign link for the POC statement of work (Marissa.action)
- Jordan: prepare architecture slide and SOC 2 artifact pointers for Nov 11 kickoff (Jordan.action)
- Mei / Rajiv: send any additional procurement fields back within 3 business days (Mei.action)

We’ll aim to run the POC Nov 15 — Feb 13 (90 days) assuming paperwork completes next week.

Thanks — looking forward.

—Liam
